parent_objective: add env-level soft-boundary support required before metric-selected measured validation
blocked_by: current env offtrack termination is hard-coded at abs(lateral_error) > track_width
fresh actual success under the selected metric needs executed rollout with soft-boundary continuation
track_width scaling would alter actor-visible road geometry and is not an acceptable proxy
supersedes: direct measured rollout before soft-boundary env support

public_gates: M2441 must preserve default offtrack termination behavior
M2441 must add opt-in soft-boundary continuation without actor input changes
M2441 must add focused tests for default and enabled behavior
M2441 must not run measured rollout, repair, train, rank candidates/controllers, select winners, or make verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run new measured rollout
do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not claim actual success improvement
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: adds prerequisite environment support for fresh measured validation under the selected hard/soft metric
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: environment infrastructure only; no new measured rollout, actual success claim, repair execution, training, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if implementation changes actor observation shape or adds oracle inputs
stop if default offtrack behavior changes
stop if implementation starts measured validation
stop if implementation claims scenario redesign was executed
fallback_plan: route to measured-validation implementation design if env support passes
route to task-boundary contract revision if env support is unsafe
route to current-sim stop if soft-boundary support cannot preserve actor contract
stop for user review if no bounded route is supported

admission_evidence: M2440 identifies hard-coded offtrack termination as a blocker
M2440 requires soft-boundary continuation without actor observation changes
allowed_updates: M2441 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the implementation result
next_stage_criteria: soft-boundary enabled behavior continues inside tolerance
diagnostic info includes soft and hard boundary state
a bounded measured-validation implementation route is registered or the route is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2441 changes env metric infrastructure and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2441; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If soft-boundary support cannot preserve default behavior and actor contract, stop before measured validation.
allowed_claims: test-backed prerequisite infrastructure for future measured validation

no actual success improvement, controller ranking, candidate-family ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: adds prerequisite runtime support for fresh measured validation instead of another old-row relabel
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can enable measured validation under selected task metrics; cannot itself establish current-sim or paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: another same-data relabel panel is proposed instead of fresh validation support

hypothesis: Opt-in soft-boundary env support can enable metric-selected rollout while preserving default behavior and actor input contract.
success_criteria: soft-boundary env support is implemented behind opt-in config
default offtrack behavior remains unchanged in focused tests
enabled behavior continues inside tolerance and terminates beyond tolerance in focused tests
no rollout repair training ranking actual-success or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2441 changes default offtrack termination behavior
M2441 treats old soft success as actual success
M2441 makes current-sim, paper, FW-vs-GRU, or self-ID verdict claims

commands.name: focused-tests
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_soft_boundary_env_support.py

decision_rule: M2441 passes if it adds opt-in soft-boundary env support with focused tests and no rollout, repair, training, ranking, actual-success, or verdict claims.
